state.label: World state
state.explain: What exists: things, their kinds and their typed fields.

rules.label: Rules
rules.explain: What can change and how: action kinds, checks, effects, processes.

acting.label: Acting
acting.explain: How a decider's choice becomes a recorded event.

noticing.label: Noticing
noticing.explain: How an actor comes to know what happened.

nodes.label: World
nodes.explain: The one canonical world of a run: entities, a tick, a revision and the events so far.

nodes.label: Category (kind of thing)
nodes.explain: What kind of thing an entity is (person, place, door, helicopter); rules select by category.

nodes.label: Entity (thing)
nodes.explain: Any thing in the world, a person, a wall or a glass alike, with a stable id and typed components.

nodes.label: Component (state field)
nodes.explain: A typed field on an entity (location, water level, passable, role); the only thing effects change. A disposition (a wall cannot be walked through) is a component value plus the checks that read it. Held in Entity.components; each component type is registered by register_component (model.py:188).

nodes.label: Place
nodes.explain: An entity of category place; every other entity's location names the place it is in.

nodes.label: Way between places
nodes.explain: What lies between two places (a door, a brick wall): an entity naming both places with a passable field; moving names its way and needs it passable. Until fix F6 lands (Q25, settled by argument), a way works from its first place to its second only.

nodes.label: Action kind (effector)
nodes.explain: Something an actor can try, with named participant roles, checks and effects, compiled before use (a generated DeclaredActionMechanic) or hand-written (FillRule and the other mechanisms); either way the Engine runs it through the action-rule interface.

nodes.label: Action and process rule interface
nodes.explain: What the Engine actually runs: an action rule discovers, checks and applies one action kind; a process rule says when it is due and applies; both declare read and write paths. Generated mechanics and the hand-written mechanisms library (FillRule, VesselFailureSpillProcess) both implement it.

nodes.label: Rule registry
nodes.explain: The sole lookup surface for the action and process rules installed in one world, in a fixed order.

nodes.label: Hard causal parent
nodes.explain: An earlier event a rule declares as mechanically supporting this one (opt-in, DeclaresCausalParents); kept apart from information a person merely had in mind. S2's reactions cite their trigger this way.

nodes.label: Participant role
nodes.explain: A named slot of an action kind (actor, to, way, aircraft) and the categories that may fill it.

nodes.label: Sense binding
nodes.explain: The meaning and participant roles Linguistic Core gives an action kind; never its effects.

nodes.label: Check (precondition)
nodes.explain: A test a move or process must pass against current state (the way is passable, the trainee can fly); a failed check refuses the move with the check named.

nodes.label: Effect
nodes.explain: A change to one component path that runs when every check holds, inside the declared write scope.

nodes.label: Declared write scope
nodes.explain: The paths a rule may change; the Engine refuses any change outside them.

nodes.label: Process (knock-on rule)
nodes.explain: A rule the world runs by itself each round for every matching entity whose checks hold; this is how effects propagate (plants dry out, lessons arrive).

nodes.label: Same-moment knock-on
nodes.explain: A process with timing immediately, run to a fixpoint inside the same moment as the move that triggered it (planned slice S2 of docs/plans/open_attempt.md). Planned, not built.

nodes.label: Skill roll
nodes.explain: A seeded roll on an action kind so a move can partly succeed or fail by skill (planned slice S3). Planned, not built.

nodes.label: Terminal condition
nodes.explain: A state-derived stop: when its checks hold over the selected entities, the task ends one way.

nodes.label: Frozen mechanic profile
nodes.explain: The validated rules of one world frozen under an id before any run.

nodes.label: Affordance (offered move)
nodes.explain: A move an actor can make now: an action kind with participants bound and its checks holding, as Engine.discover lists it.

nodes.label: Decider (policy)
nodes.explain: What chooses an actor's next move: scripted, an AI menu chooser or a Concordia resident.

nodes.label: Attempt (free text)
nodes.explain: What a resident says it tries, in its own words; never executable.

nodes.label: Attempt reading
nodes.explain: The interpreter's typed reading of an attempt: an action kind and participants, with no outcome field, or no match.

nodes.label: Unmatched attempt
nodes.explain: An attempt no action kind covers; it changes nothing and is listed in the run's build record.

nodes.label: Typed action (command)
nodes.explain: The envelope submitted to the Engine: actor, action kind, bound participants, base revision.

nodes.label: Event
nodes.explain: The record of one attempt or process step: status, every check and its result, the changes, the cause and an id like r14-e00012.

nodes.label: Observation (sensor)
nodes.explain: What one actor can see of the world now, filtered by place and by information delivery.

nodes.label: Information and delivery (channel)
nodes.explain: An information entity and its delivery rows: who has been told what, by which channel, and when; a word said across the world reaches no one without a delivery.
